title: Onboarding policy
paragraphs: The onboarding policy requires SSO for administrator access and weekly approval review for privileged roles.
Teams must keep evidence of access review decisions for SOC 2 audit readiness.
All exceptions must be documented in the control review log.

title: Support portal guide
paragraphs: The support portal explains how to route vendor requests to the operations queue.
Dashboards can show weekly ticket volume by team.

title: Identity governance notes
paragraphs: Identity governance work should connect approval flows with access review reporting.
Quarterly control review evidence should stay easy to retrieve.
